name: Vila Nova do Sul (Brazil)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a mural crown, red flags, a bull, a hammer and pick and wheat, over a scroll reading 1976 VILA NOVA DO SUL 20-3-92.
history: Vila Nova do Sul is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 12 February 1993 (prescribed with the arms by Municipal Law No. 12 of 12 February 1993, according to Flags of the World).
